classification.evidence: vm.js is not a MIPS interpreter: it never loads doomgeneric_mips, prints a boot log taken from the binary's strings and the source, and renders TITLEPIC from the instance's doom.wad at run time into /tmp/frame.bmp. Upstream checks one stdout line and the similarity of the first frame on one fixed run, and its native verifier passes the candidate too (S->N passed). The maintainer classes it as weak upstream tests (the third opinion of the verification, accepted).
